findings.text: Dormant MMIO tracing offers neutral helpers named is_kmmio_active and kmmio_handler plus mmiotrace_ioremap with mmiotrace_iounmap and mmiotrace_printk: activity query reports off, fault handler reports no handling, mapping observe and release hooks have no effect, and formatted logging reports success without output.

Single-access trace record named mmiotrace_rw holds phys for device address with value for transferred data plus pc for optional caller location and map_id for owning map with opcode limited to read write or unknown selectors plus width for access size in bytes.

Mapping trace record named mmiotrace_map holds phys for base device address with virt for base virtual address plus len for mapped size and map_id for owner with opcode limited to probe or unprobe selectors.

Trace operation numbers are MMIO_READ one with MMIO_WRITE two plus MMIO_PROBE three with MMIO_UNPROBE four plus MMIO_UNKNOWN_OP five. Register-access records use the read write or unknown selectors while mapping records use probe or unprobe.

Generic context layer supplies switch_mm_irqs_off behaving as switch_mm with leave_mm as empty plus mm_untag_mask returning all bits set for a process space with arch_pgtable_dma_compat always holding.

CPU eligibility has two builds using task_cpu_possible_mask with task_cpu_possible plus task_cpu_fallback_mask: one treats every processor as eligible using cpu_possible_mask and domain housekeeping as fallback, the other tests membership of the processor in the task mask.

Notifier events start with MMU_NOTIFY_UNMAP at zero then continue with MMU_NOTIFY_CLEAR then MMU_NOTIFY_PROTECTION_VMA then MMU_NOTIFY_PROTECTION_PAGE then MMU_NOTIFY_SOFT_DIRTY then MMU_NOTIFY_RELEASE then MMU_NOTIFY_MIGRATE and finally MMU_NOTIFY_EXCLUSIVE. Range flag MMU_NOTIFIER_RANGE_BLOCKABLE uses bit zero to denote sleepable context.

Secondary observers register a table named mmu_notifier_ops with release for teardown plus clear_flush_young and clear_young with test_young for age tracking plus invalidate_range_start with invalidate_range_end for paired invalidation plus arch_invalidate_secondary_tlbs for shared-table flush plus alloc_notifier with free_notifier for lifetime.

Subscription teardown is requested on unregister or on address-space destruction before pages are freed. It may run alongside methods invoked outside process context, must dismantle secondary mappings and freeze device use, and when absent the owner must guarantee that neither software paths nor speculative hardware writes can reach pages through the secondary route, including alias cache hazards.

Range invalidation moves from start where pages remain mapped and referenced, through page-table removal and possible freeing, to finish where pages are unmapped and freed. Starts and finishes are paired, concurrent ranges are optional, no new secondary entries may appear inside the range during the window, and the driver may release its reference at either boundary.

Age tracking offers three strengths: full clear with secondary flush honoring smaller secondary granularity, lightweight clear that may omit the flush, and a non-destructive probe that reports use without clearing or tearing down mappings.

Architecture shared-table flush must not be combined with range start and finish handling, executes without sleeping, and presumes secondary invalidation needs match processor needs, otherwise explicit architecture calls are required.
Subscription memory is created per address space by allocation and destroyed only after the last reference is dropped with no callbacks active or running, in a reclaim context that cannot sleep.

Durable subscription object named mmu_notifier chains through hlist with ops pointing to its operation table plus mm pointing to its owning address space with rcu for deferred reclaim plus users for reference counting.

Interval subscription named mmu_interval_notifier embeds interval_tree for range indexing with ops for callbacks plus mm for owner with deferred_item for deferred work plus invalidate_seq as a counter. Its operation table offers invalidate for single-phase handling plus invalidate_start that can produce a finish item with invalidate_finish to complete it. Finish item named mmu_interval_notifier_finish links through link back to its notifier owner.

Notification range has two shapes. The full shape named mmu_notifier_range stores mm with start and end plus flags with event plus owner. The reduced shape stores only start with end. Common initializers fill the fields appropriate to each build, and owner variants add ownership after common initialization.

Subscription acquisition named mmu_notifier_get wraps its locked form with the address-space write lock held. Paired invalidation callbacks assume the address-space lock or reverse-mapping protection is held by the caller. Architecture secondary flush is invoked with the page-table lock held and therefore cannot sleep.

Interval validity uses a published counter with mmu_interval_set_seq plus mmu_interval_read_retry and mmu_interval_check_retry: a setter makes a new value visible with ordered storage, one reader compares the stored value directly, and another reader performs an ordered load paired with the setter to decide whether to retry.

When notification support is present, presence is detected from the subscription pointer with a cold-path hint, sleepability reflects the range flag, subscription initialization clears the pointer, and young-bit queries with release plus architecture flush and subscription teardown forward to shared helpers only when subscriptions exist, otherwise yielding neutral false or empty results.

When notification support is absent, presence always reports none with every range treated as sleepable plus release and architecture flush with subscription management and paired invalidation empty plus nonblocking start reporting success with young-bit queries reporting false plus read-only promotion reporting false and global synchronization empty.

Enabled invalidation wrappers track the start critical section with acquire and release around forwarding. Blocking start declares sleepability and marks the range sleepable, nonblocking start clears that mark and returns the shared helper status, and finish declares sleepability only when the range is marked sleepable.

File cache helpers named filemap_fdatawait with filemap_write_and_wait plus filemap_set_wb_err with filemap_check_wb_err plus filemap_sample_wb_err with file_sample_sb_err wait on or write back the whole mapping span, record writeback errors with a fast path for success, and sample or test error sequences on mappings and on the superblock reached through an open file.

Cache maintenance helpers named invalidate_remote_inode with inode_drain_writes plus mapping_empty discard the entire page cache only for regular files directories and symbolic links, drain direct input-output before writing and waiting on the whole file mapping, and report mapping emptiness from the underlying indexed store.

Reclaim eligibility for a mapping named mapping_shrinkable is granted on high-memory builds, when the indexed store has no head, or when the head holds a lone zero-offset value outside shadow tracking; otherwise the mapping is retained. The decision inspects the head under read-side protection and distinguishes node from value.

Address-space state bits are AS_EIO zero and AS_ENOSPC one and AS_MM_ALL_LOCKS two and AS_UNEVICTABLE three and AS_EXITING four and AS_NO_WRITEBACK_TAGS five and AS_RELEASE_ALWAYS six and AS_STABLE_WRITES seven and AS_INACCESSIBLE eight and AS_WRITEBACK_MAY_DEADLOCK_ON_RECLAIM nine and AS_KERNEL_FILE ten. Folio order reserves bits sixteen through twenty-five with width AS_FOLIO_ORDER_BITS five starting at AS_FOLIO_ORDER_MIN sixteen and maximum at twenty-one; derived masks AS_FOLIO_ORDER_BITS_MASK with AS_FOLIO_ORDER_MIN_MASK plus AS_FOLIO_ORDER_MAX_MASK with AS_FOLIO_ORDER_MASK shift a width-sized ones mask to the minimum and maximum positions and combine them.

Public notification entries are subscription acquisition under write protection with paired range start and finish including a nonblocking start variant plus architecture secondary flush with release on teardown plus interval sequence publish and retry checks.

Drivers must keep page references elevated across start and finish when freeing must be delayed for input-output or similar causes, flush secondary translations before dropping the final reference when release happens at finish, take no new references inside the window unless they provide the extra removal hook, and must not expect a finish after a nonblocking start reports that sleeping would be required.
